title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account. They have tried resetting their password but still cannot access the account.

title: Payment Failed - Card Declined
description: Customer attempted to pay using their card but the payment was declined during checkout.

title: Unable to Download Invoice
description: Customer cannot download their invoice from the billing section. The download button is not working.

title: Incorrect Billing Address
description: Customer's billing address appears incorrect. They submitted a request to update their billing information.

title: App Crash on Launch
description: Customer reports that the mobile application crashes immediately after opening the app.

title: Refund Not Processed
description: Customer requested a refund but the refund has not been processed yet.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Issue
description: Customer is not receiving the two-factor authentication code when trying to log in.

title: Unable to Update Profile Picture
description: Customer cannot update their profile picture from the account settings page.

title: Subscription Auto-Renewal
description: Customer wants to disable automatic subscription renewal but cannot find the option in settings.

title: Missing Order Confirmation Email
description: Customer placed an order but did not receive the order confirmation email even though the payment was successful.
